concepts.title: 07 / HORIZON
concepts.detail: Design a compact abstract horizon emblem made from a terracotta half-disc sun partly emerging behind a dark ink horizontal arc that becomes a subtly wide lower bowl. Its silhouette should suggest the world expanding into view, a new day and new knowledge, with broad strokes and a precise horizontal negative-space seam. Do not draw a full scenic landscape, waves or rays. A sophisticated geometric emblem, not a weather icon. Main colors deep warm ink #27262c and muted burnt orange #c76c45. Dark ink rounded-square app icon with cream and terracotta symbol.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a landscape 4:3 first-round logo concept presentation board for OtherWise, a personal discovery app helping people find meaningful new topics beyond their existing interests. Calm curiosity, a wider world, intelligent but approachable. One single original coherent logo concept per board.
Layout: clean warm off-white background, generous whitespace. Small numbered concept heading at the top left. A large graphic symbol in left center, exact wordmark "OtherWise" directly below the symbol. Right side has two smaller applications of the EXACT same symbol: a solid one-color version at top and an app-icon rounded square version below. The main symbol is the visual focus. Crisp flat vector-style edges and bold simple geometry, carefully designed negative space. A readable contemporary sans-serif wordmark, perfectly correct spelling and capitalization. No photo mockups, no gradients, no texture, no drop shadows, no paragraphs, no decorative doodles, no watermarks. Small-icon usability, no hairline strokes. Each board should feel like thoughtful graphic design rather than stock clipart.
Text (verbatim), only these strings: "07 / HORIZON" and "OtherWise".

concepts.title: 08 / DETOUR
concepts.detail: Design an original compact branching-path emblem: a sturdy dark navy smooth path rises from the bottom and curves to the upper left, while one coral branch smoothly diverges to the upper right and bends slightly outward. Both routes terminate with blunt rounded ends, not arrowheads. The overall silhouette is a distinctive asymmetric wide Y with the negative space between branches carefully shaped like an opening. Express choosing an unexpected but meaningful route. No circle, no dot, no map pin, no generic navigation arrow. Navy #101a29, warm coral #e58b78. Friendly but grown-up.

concepts.title: 09 / APERTURE
concepts.detail: Design a distinctive compact aperture emblem with just THREE broad curved blade shapes, arranged rotationally around a generous slightly triangular rounded negative-space opening. It should look like a view opening into possibilities, asymmetric optical motion, not a camera lens or mechanical shutter. The blades are solid flat plum #493454 and soft peach #e7b08d, strong clean silhouettes. Do not use 5 or 6 blades, tiny details, stars, circles or multicolor rainbow. Avoid resemblance to existing AI provider logos; original simple 3-part construction. Dark plum square app icon, cream and peach emblem.

concepts.title: 10 / ATLAS
concepts.detail: Design a minimal folded-map emblem using three upright broad connected panels, making a compact angular zigzag silhouette with softly rounded outer corners. Clever negative-space zigzag path travels diagonally across the folds, implying exploring unfamiliar terrain and connections between topics. Main mark navy #101a29 with muted sage #93b4a5 middle panel. The mark should read as an abstract folded atlas, not a literal detailed map, not a book, not paper planes. No pins, no labels, no geographic outlines, no circles. Strong graphic geometry.

concepts.title: 11 / STEPSTONES
concepts.detail: Design a bold playful yet premium emblem made from THREE large organic rounded pebble shapes stepping diagonally upwards to the right, with the middle cobalt-blue pebble slightly overlapping the first and the final vivid orange pebble clearly separated by a small deliberate gap. Carefully coordinate the pebble silhouettes into a compact dynamic glyph suggesting small connected discoveries leading somewhere new. Not a generic three-dot ellipsis, not an app grid, not beads, no outlines or circles. Palette deep cobalt #3555d9, warm orange #f28a45, cream. Cobalt rounded-square icon contains cream pebbles and orange last pebble. Make the main wordmark bold and friendly.

concepts.title: 12 / WISE
concepts.detail: Design a minimalist abstract owl brand symbol that lightly references the word Wise: one bold dark navy rounded body silhouette, TWO large intelligent eye holes shaped as soft vertical ovals, and an elegant central downward wedge created from negative space, with very subtle small upper ear corners. No wings, no feathers, no realistic animal rendering, no eyebrows, no angry sports mascot expression, no owl perched on book. Calm curious friendly adult personality. The face structure subtly suggests the letters O and W without using text inside the mark. A compact original iconic silhouette with just a small muted golden yellow #d9b867 accent on one eye rim. Navy #182536 and cream. Avoid recognizable owl mascots from language-learning apps. Elegant humanist wordmark.
